items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And then, I stayed, he's always been a close friend, you know.

ctx.x: And I, and I said well, I'd like to give it a chance. He came up to the Savoy to see me during those first few weeks up there. And then, I stayed, he's always been a close friend, you know. I went down to see a show here. It

was like last week or the week before last. I saw Mercer. Mercer. He said—Mercer, said 'When are you coming on down to see me?' I said well, I happened to have 3 or 4 days off and I went by and caught it. I enjoyed it. It brought back a lot of memories, especially with Duke and myself.
